discription: A warm and evolving pad sound using a sawtooth oscillator, an ADSR envelope with long release, and a low-pass filter with slow LFO modulation on its cutoff frequency.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, cutoff=2000, lfoFreq=0.5, lfoDepth=500; var sig, env, lfo; env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 1.0, 0.7, 2.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); sig = Saw.ar(freq); lfo = SinOsc.kr(lfoFreq) * lfoDepth; sig = RLPF.ar(sig, cutoff + lfo, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
